constraints.times: Signing time and evaluation time are separate. Historical status is checked only at signed_at; present authority is checked at evaluated_at. Both are caller supplied untrusted timestamps (no TSA verification).
constraints.evidence_links: HTTPS URI and SHA256 over locally supplied canonicalized JSON fixture content; NO remote dereferencing
constraints.coverage_boundary: credential_verified is fixture-provided simulated issuer attestation; cryptographic credential verification not implemented; no cryptographic signature coverage validation; labels are simulated.
constraints.generator: local generator rejection or acceptance recorded separately from authority; no actual generator signing or manifest emission

known_exclusions: credential revocation checks beyond simulated chain state
